annotations.title: Grade a C and embedded interview practice answer

description: Grades a C answer to a C and embedded interview practice problem, exactly as the breadboardhub practice page does: the code is compiled with avr-gcc for the ATmega328P together with hidden tests and run on an emulated chip. Send only the functions the problem asks for (the header is provided). Returns pass or fail, how many test cases pass and the first failing call with its expected and actual value, or the compiler errors in the code. Signed-in accounts get the attempt saved to their progress. Counts toward an hourly build limit.

c.description: The C source: the functions the problem asks for (at most 10,000 characters).
